_comment: Local demo seed for reviewers. Four public repositories, one per lockfile
format, matching the recorded fixtures in tests/fixtures/github/ so they scan
with no network when the backend runs with VT_FEEDS=fixtures and
DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT=dev (see the README, 'Try it as a reviewer').
Registered through the API by deploy/seed-pilot.py --seed-file
deploy/demo-seed.json. The owner names and emails are fictional. The last
entry has no owner on purpose, to show an ownerless asset.
